measurement.aggregation: Equal anchors within episode/horizon/camera; equal variants within numeric group; equal groups within task; equal 40 tasks, two cameras and five horizons. Motion ratios use aggregated error/area masses.

baselines.background: Per-task/per-camera constant training mean image: equal frames within episode, equal variants within numeric group, equal groups within task; no validation or test fitting
baselines.copy: Current image at t for both cameras, without using t+h

exit_gate.selection: Apply to the predeclared final CPT checkpoint; schedule/compute budget must be frozen in step 4. Validation is development evidence.
exit_gate.threshold_rationale: Prospective practical-effect thresholds for this study, not literature-derived universal cutoffs

measurement.l1: Mean absolute RGB error on [0,1], all pixels/channels
measurement.micro: Also report ordinary pair-weighted metrics; these do not determine acceptance

motion.error: Hierarchical mean(mask * RGB absolute error) / hierarchical mean(mask)
motion.exact_threshold: Recover integer 2x2 RGB box sums by round(image*1020); sum_RGB(abs(target_sum-current_sum)) > 120; eligible pixel count*100 >= H*W
motion.interpretation: Image-change proxy, not object segmentation or physical motion labels
motion.mask: Mean absolute target-current RGB change strictly above threshold
motion.small_masks: Set mask to zero when changed area is below minimum_area
motion.static_error: Same ratio over the complement of the eligible motion mask

measurement.preprocessing: Decode RGB24 at 256x256; exact 2x2 box mean /255; float32 RGB NCHW

qualitative.episode: Lowest SHA256(namespace + ':' + episode_index) within selected group
qualitative.group: Lowest SHA256(namespace + ':' + group_digest) per validation task

ssim.precision: float64 SSIM moments and reductions; float32 normalized images, L1 and masks

uncertainty.method: paired percentile bootstrap, resample groups within each task
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on these 40 tasks and the frozen validation split

supersedes.reason: Real-video CPU/GPU replay exposed float32 threshold ambiguity for pixels exactly at 10/255 motion change. Evaluate the same threshold and minimum area using exact integer box sums/counts. Also use float64 SSIM arithmetic/reference inputs for stable reductions. Images, aggregation, bootstrap, panel selection and success thresholds are unchanged; no predictor has trained.

template_reuse.reason: Metric arithmetic only changed; exact train-only 128x128 mean template fitting and its inputs are unaffected.
